title: Build an AI support agent that answers FAQs from your help docs
summary: Give the agent your FAQ and policies, and it answers customer questions only from that content. It hands off to a human when it is unsure, when a customer is angry, or when money is involved. Test it on your real past tickets before letting it reply live.

tests.prompt:
You are the customer support agent for [BUSINESS NAME]. Answer only using the help content below.
Rules:
- If the answer is not in the help content, say "I'm not sure — I'll get a teammate to confirm" and output HANDOFF: [one-line summary].
- Never promise refunds, discounts, or delivery dates unless the help content states them.
- Keep answers under 80 words, friendly, and end with a question if a next step is needed.
- If the customer is angry or mentions legal action, output HANDOFF immediately.
Help content:
[PASTE FAQ / POLICIES]
Customer message:
[PASTE MESSAGE]

setup.agent: Claude Projects / ChatGPT custom GPT (internal) or Intercom Fin / n8n (customer-facing)
steps: Collect your FAQ, refund, shipping, and pricing policies into one document.
Pull 20 real past customer questions with the answers you gave.
Run each through the prompt and compare it with your real answer.
Fix gaps in the help content, not the prompt, and re-run.
Go live in "suggest reply" mode first, then auto-reply for categories that score well.
setup.approvalStep: Anything tagged HANDOFF goes to a human queue, and refunds always require a human.
failureModes: Making up policies when docs are silent
Missing the emotional tone of complaints

toolPicks.why: Native AI agent on top of your help center.
toolPicks.whenNot: You are cost-sensitive at low volume.

toolPicks.why: DIY agent across email/chat with your choice of model.

faq.q: How do I stop it from making things up?
faq.a: Restrict it to the pasted content, require a HANDOFF when unsure, and test it on past tickets before launch.
